title: Why Replay Must Not Repeat Side Effects
hook: Replay reconstructs decisions. Repeating an external mutation is a bug.
thesis: PING's autonomous runtime specification distinguishes decision replay from mutation replay: restart must reconstruct what was decided, never blindly repeat external mutations. Uncertain effects reconcile instead of being retried. The episode shows the kill-point list, the journal, and the reconciliation read that replaces the retry reflex.

proven: The directive states the decision-replay vs mutation-replay distinction and requires uncertain effects to reconcile instead of blindly repeating (sections 6, 7).

The directive lists the kill points: after decision, after durable-intent persistence, after claim, during external request, after external success before response, after response before verification, after verification before canonical recording (section 6).
partial: That failure injection at these kill points is implemented and exercised in the current runtime.
unknown: Recorded failure-injection runs, event evidence, and replay fixtures that can be cited or reproduced publicly.

approval_gate: Nolan approves every exact post. Silence is not approval.
